messages:
elaine_sales: Quick ask from CapitalOneX POC: strict EU residency, BYO-KMS, and explicit no-US subprocessors in scope. Need region list, subproc attestations, routing failover policy we can show legal, and POC pricing delta. Deadline Mon EOD.

ryan_sre: We can pin tenants to eu-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-west-3. Storage runs in-EU (AWS/GCS EU zones). Monitoring is Datadog EU tenancy but awaiting their formal attestation about support access. I'll provide perf notes and a short region matrix.

tara_se: BYO-KMS supported for Dedicated/Private. Customer must supply KMS ARN and a cross-account role. We use envelope encryption and do not import raw keys. Flag: BYO-KMS triggers a compliance review (~7 biz days). Will upload runbook + sample IAM role policy.

simon_presales: Pricing: geo-pin add-on +14% for short POC; strict EU-only (no global fallback) +23% due to reserved capacity. For a 30-day POC we can offer a one-time promo to waive geo-pin if they commit to Dedicated within 60 days. Preparing two quotes now.

vendor_bot: Ticket CREATED-824: Requesting Datadog EU access attestation. ETA 4 business days. Link: https://intra.redwood/subproc/824

harry_security: If they insist no US subprocessors at all we need legal to sign an addendum; also confirm whether Datadog access from non-EU IPs is acceptable. Escalating to Legal.

elaine_sales: Action items: (1) @ryan_sre region matrix + perf numbers, (2) @tara_se BYO-KMS runbook + IAM sample, (3) @simon_presales two quote variants and waiver language, (4) @harry_security/legal vendor attestation. Need all by Mon EOD.

ryan_sre: Confirmed regions + short perf table sent to the shared drive. Proposed routing policy snippet to show legal: "pin_primary=EU; standby=EU-only; global_fallback=false; consent_required=true".
